title: Fields beside the town
changes: Paid Terraced fields use low stepped beds beside the town, clear of its crest. Homes and other selected buildings remain visible.
Construction shows unfinished beds and stakes; completed fields show broad crop strips. The new shapes stay inside the town tile and do not change Food, land ownership or the simulation.

title: Preparing useful new towns
changes: Civilizations can compare new town locations with room for later work and shorter possible contact, while protecting the people and supplies needed at home.
A new empty town may favor paid Terraced fields. Founding and construction remain separate choices: three residents move, every cost is paid, and Food appears only after actual work is completed.

title: Small forest charcoal clearings
changes: Civilizations can build a paid clearing on an owned forest site after Kiln firing. Later seasons use one resident and Materials to make ordinary Energy; the forest remains.

Autonomous choices weigh useful Energy, operating supplies and other forest uses. The map keeps the low charcoal mound, wood stacks and surrounding trees; paused or short-supplied sites show no operating cue.
